source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 9 June 1958, p. 10 ("Notice of result of elections: Rural District of Larne")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed after the withdrawal of Mr. V. R. Ledlie: the official notice records one name only for the division

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. One contest had been expected in Glenarm North between V. R. Ledlie and Margaret Beckwith, but Ledlie withdrew and Beckwith was returned unopposed (Belfast Telegraph, 9 June 1958, p. 10, official notice of result; Larne Times, 13 June 1958). The first woman elected to the council. Returned unopposed.
